signals.content: Hivemind's first flight in orbit. Onboard a NOVI Space satellite in low Earth orbit, Hivemind integrated with Sedaro’s Autonomy Framework for the Edge (SAFE), demonstrating trusted satellite autonomy capabilities. Hivemind made autonomous mission decisions while SAFE provided mission assurance, showing how autonomy can help operators move from managing a single satellite to coordinating fleets at scale. The demonstration also proved that Hivemind can operate on existing satellites not originally designed for autonomy. Full release: https://t.co/NVeh0pnofL Autonomy for the world. The greatest victory requires no war.
